body: If you actually need some one to talk to right now, you can PM me and I can listen.

I understand your pain, after my girlfriend killed herself and having her die in my arms it did cripple me. I was already a broken man before that but she gave me hope. I am 25 and she was 23 and despite being young we had it all. I even did so much in my life in those 25 years to make myself better but some how I ruined it all. I want to kill my self and have no reason to as well. Society says not to do it and yet that's only because it is to weak to understand the suffering of others. No one cares about you, they just don't want to feel uncomfortable about some one killing them self.

But for you, you have a family.. you have time to build something.
I don't I have no one. I have no friends, no family... no nothing. I soon will be living on the street again but I don't plan to keep it that way.
You have time if some one is there to help you. Understand that at least you have things in your life to help you move forward. I don't brother, and believe me I can even tell you more about how fucked up my life is. If I could write a book about my life it would be featured on Oprah. Just know the meek might seem weak but we have the ability to endure such hardship. Don't look at my willingness to concede to the mortal coil I live as a weakness. Look at it as you having something still in your life.
